about: Reading back to the edge of what is loaded: an older page lands above the passage, photos above it finish loading later and grow up out of view; the passage stays through both. ↓ then reaches the end at once and the next reply follows. A quote then lands on a photo still loading: the reader is on the picture, which grows down and stays where it is read. In another room a quote lands on a loading photo and a 31 px wheel moves it to start just above the band: it grows up out of view, its bottom and the text after it stay.

b.name: A photo at the band's top
